topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: I was out in the garden, just tending to the soil as I often do, when my spade hit something hard. Curious, I cleared the earth around it and there it was—a small, metal box, sealed tight and marked with a date from decades past. It didn't ring any bells, no memories of burying it. With a mix of hesitation and eagerness, I opened it. Inside, there were letters, photographs, and a vinyl record. Each item felt like a piece of a puzzle, a story waiting to be uncovered. The letters were filled with dreams and musings, the photographs captured faces both familiar and strange. It’s as if the past is reaching out, offering a glimpse of what once was, and maybe, what could be. I’ve decided to listen to the record tomorrow, imagining the music or words that filled the air back then.
